summary: This Form 8-K reports that Jones Soda Co. issued 7.5 million units at $0.33 per unit, each consisting of one share and half a warrant exercisable at $0.45 for 36 months, for $2.5 million gross proceeds. The offering was made under Rule 506(b) and Regulation S as a private placement with registration rights. No special-situation transformation (merger, tender, activist, restructuring, etc.) is announced; this is a routine capital raise. The filing registers unregistered sales and a material definitive agreement but does not constitute a special-situations event.
